# Revol Digital

> Revol Digital builds fast, SEO-optimized React websites for businesses, startups and professionals. Founded by Ridhy Mishra, a full-stack web developer, the studio delivers custom web development, responsive design and performance-focused solutions using React, Node.js, Python and Tailwind CSS.

Revol Digital designs and develops custom React websites focused on converting visitors into customers through clean code, modern UI/UX and long-term maintainability. Every project is discussed and scoped before development starts, with transparent, defined pricing.

## Services
- Full-Stack Website Development — end-to-end frontend, backend and database architecture
- Landing Page Engineering — conversion-focused pages for campaigns and offers
- SEO & Performance Optimization — Core Web Vitals, technical SEO and page speed
- UI/UX Engineering — clean, intuitive interface design
- Website Redesign — modernizing outdated websites
- Long-Term Support — ongoing maintenance, security and updates

## Pricing
- Starter Website: from ₹8,999 (custom responsive UI, SEO-friendly structure, 3–4 day delivery)
- Business Website: from ₹18,999 (conversion-focused UI/UX, CMS/admin panel, analytics, 7–10 day delivery)
- Custom Web Application: custom quote (React frontend with Node.js/Python backend, API integrations)
